goals.title: What the whole repository is for, in one sentence
goals.notes: The root of the plan. Every goal below names the files it touches and the suite that judges it; a goal that cannot say either is not ready to be a goal. The plan reader reports a touched path that is not there, a judge that is not there, a parent or an after edge that points nowhere - a healthy plan reports an empty missing list.
